newsitem.title: CONGO: Heavy shooting heard from Brazzaville airport.
newsitem.headline: Heavy shooting heard from Brazzaville airport.

text.p: Heavy shooting broke out in the area of the Congo capital Brazzaville's airport on Thursday after an overnight lull in clashes that ended a fragile week-old truce, witnesses said.

Both sides in the conflict -- supporters of President Pascal Lissouba and those of his predecessor, former military leader Denis Sassou Nguesso -- claimed to control the airport after a day of fierce fighting there on Wednesday.
Fighting erupted in Brazzaville on June 5 and 1,000 to 3,000 people have been killed.
